description:
The COURT CONTROL™ FF 4 shoe is recommended for badminton players seeking cushioning and support. This shoe is targeted for players that engage in long rallies with a jump and smash style of play.

The midsole features FF BLAST™ PLUS foam for enhanced cushioning, comfort, and responsiveness, while the upper PU (polyurethane) construction helps provide a better fit with more support and flexibility to help players quickly shift directions.

The shoe is also enhanced with DYNALACING™ technology to help provide support exactly where you need it, creating a lock-in feel for quick transitions on the court. Additionally, the spacious toebox structure offers more space around the little toe for reduced pressure and improved overall comfort.
